name: planora-widget
description: Planora widget: an installable bug & feature reporting bubble for any website.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @planora/widget-contract && npm run build -w @planora/widget && npm run build -w @planora/widget-loader && npm run build -w @planora/widget-react
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n core,loader,api,site -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @planora/widget" "npm run dev -w @planora/widget-loader" "npm run dev -w @planora/mock-api" "npm run dev -w @planora/playground"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contract && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/loader && tsc -p packages/react --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mock-api && tsc -p apps/playground
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:php && npm run size
